How Cybersecurity Software Knows a Hack Is Happening

In July 2024, the cybersecurity firm KnowBe4 found itself in a quagmire: it had inadvertently hired a North Korean cyberattacker posing as a U.S.-based IT worker. The would-be employee had made it through four video interviews and background checks using a stolen U.S. identity and an AI-altered image.
